secondary_descriptive.note: Descriptive only. No threshold was set for this and none is applied after the fact.

scope: NOT a replication. RPE1 covers 24.3% of K562's knockdown targets and that subset is disproportionately essential genes -- see the rpe1_coverage_collision control in results/frozen/controls.csv, which FAILS at 94.1% vs 11.3% coverage. This arm tests whether the structure holds in a second cell line, nothing more.
